title: Chapter 26: Current Affairs — West Bengal Focus

blocks.content: Kanyashree Prakalpa was honored with the UN Public Service Award for its impactful role in empowering young women.

rows: Promote higher education and prevent child marriage
Provide direct monthly financial support to women
Provide doorstep delivery of government welfare services

items: Exams frequently test the launch years and primary objectives of West Bengal flagship schemes like Kanyashree, Lakshmir Bhandar, and Duare Sarkar.
Pay special attention to recently granted GI Tags from West Bengal for WBCS and UPSC Prelims art & culture questions.
Remember key statistics regarding West Bengal's agricultural outputs, particularly rice and jute production rankings.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Kanyashree Prakalpa was launched in 2013 to improve the status and wellbeing of female children by encouraging higher education and delaying early marriage.
The 'Duare Sarkar' outreach campaign was introduced to deliver key state welfare services directly at the doorstep of citizens.
West Bengal has secured several Geographical Indication (GI) tags including Sundarban Honey, Black Nunia Rice, Tangail, Garod, and Kadi Yal Sarees.
Lakshmir Bhandar provides direct financial assistance to female heads of families aged between 25 and 60 years.
West Bengal remains a leading state in rice production and inland fisheries in India.
